verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is API-first, so it can be driven without a UI. Requests use bearer tokens plus ECDSA request signing, which suits server-side machine auth (truelayer-docs-12). Official SDKs automate signing (truelayer-docs-11, truelayer-docs-24), a test-payment sandbox flow exists (truelayer-docs-32), and payments on an authorised mandate execute without further user authorisation (truelayer-docs-16). However, the evidence never documents running it in CI. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/headless test-automation guidance (e.g. non-interactive sandbox bank authorisation), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
